content:
The first release candidate v4.3.0-rc1 for the v4.3.0 release of Lean is available now. This releases addresses many previously identified bugs, and resolves several community requests about the behaviour of simp.

Std/Aesop/Mathlib have now moved their main/master branches to use this release, so you have all the goodies to try out now!

This is a release candidate, so please expect some rough edges. Please report any issues you find! If anyone finds anything that is a regression relative to v4.2.0, we will likely make a new release candidate. Otherwise, we hope for this to become v4.3.0 at the end of November.
